anomalies.observed: On the Microcontroller sheet (mcu.kicad_sch), the WS2812B status LED D3 has its data input pin 4 (DIN) labelled NET0004, but the net name NET0004 appears nowhere on any pin of U8 (ESP32-C3-MINI-1). The only net boxes on U8 are NET0011/NET0017 (left), NET0007/NET0012 (USB), NET0008/NET0001/NET0005/NET0003 (SPI), NET0006 (SO), plus TP2/TP4 and the fan-tach protection nets NET0002/NET0018. Thus D3.DIN/NET0004 is a floating net with no driver.
anomalies.expected: The specification requires the onboard WS2812B status LED to be driven by the MCU (TL;DR: 'a single onboard WS2812B status LED (D1)'; firmware/src/led.rs sets its colour per run state), so D3.DIN must be connected to one of the ESP32-C3 GPIOs.

evidence.quote: mcu.kicad_sch: D3 WS2812B, pin 4 DIN -> NET0004, pin 1 VDD -> +3V3, pin 3 VSS -> GND, pin 2 DOUT -> NC; NET0004 not present on any U8 pin

anomalies.impact: The status LED has no data input tied to the microcontroller, so the firmware's per-state colour output never reaches the WS2812B; the onboard status indication is lost (LED stays off / at its power-on default).
